audience: online shops on ikas that check orders, stock and customers

useCases.title: Find orders waiting for shipment
useCases.text: List orders filtered by order number or customer email, and read their package and payment status.

useCases.title: Look up a customer by email
useCases.text: Search customers by email, phone or a text term. Read only the fields the request needs.

useCases.title: Check stock for a SKU
useCases.text: List products filtered by SKU or brand, and read the total stock, variants and barcodes.

useCases.title: Confirm the store connection
useCases.text: Read the id of the Private App to confirm that the client ID and secret work.
